name: CMS Interoperability & AI Governance (Thin)
description: Thin CMS-aligned policy pack for runtime governance of interoperability, patient/provider/payer access, prior authorization workflow stages, API/FHIR access, data exchange, and AI/agent use. Healthcare Pack #4. Does not determine CMS compliance.
semantic_notes: Applicability is explicit (CMS tag + healthcare_interop.applicability) — Healthcare+AI alone does not imply CMS
Prior Authorization is one family among several — not the organizing principle of the pack
Unknown applicability does not auto-REVIEW; restrictive rules require applicability=applicable
Human review is exception-based via explicit REVIEW rules only where policy requires it
deliberately_not_implemented: Full Prior Authorization product / FHIR PA CRD/DTR/PAS implementation
CMS certification or legal compliance determination
Separate CMS PDP / audit store / UI
